 local function request(command,payload,fn,valid,failure)
  table.insert(requestQueue,{command,payload,fn,valid,failure})
  if processing then return end processing=true
  task.spawn(function()
   while alive and #requestQueue>0 do
    local item=table.remove(requestQueue,1)
    if not item[4] or item[4]() then
     task.wait(math.max(0,.16-(os.clock()-lastRequest)))
     if not alive then break end
     if not item[4] or item[4]() then
      lastRequest=os.clock() local ok,success,message=pcall(remote.InvokeServer,remote,item[1],item[2])
      if not alive then break end

local Rig={}
local Hold=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.WeaponHold)

local started=false
function Rig:Clear(tool)
 local r=records[tool] if not r then return end records[tool]=nil
 for _,connection in r.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
 for _,object in r.owned do if object.Parent then object:Destroy() end end
 for _,joint in r.disabled do if joint.Parent then joint.Enabled=true end end
 tool:SetAttribute("SupportGripActive",false)
end
local function own(record,value) table.insert(record.owned,value) return value end
function Rig:Attach(tool)
 if records[tool] then return end
 local character=tool.Parent local h=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") local handle=tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
 if not h or h.Health<=0 or not handle or not tool:GetAttribute("TwoHanded") then return end
 local support=handle:FindFirstChild("SupportGrip")
 -- A muzzle is a firing origin, not a hand target. Do not mutate attachments on equip.
 if not support then return end
 local torso=character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso") if not torso then return end
 local r={owned={},connections={},disabled={}} records[tool]=r
 if h.RigType==Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
  if handle:FindFirstChild("RightHandGrip") then
   for _,joint in character:GetDescendants() do if joint:IsA("JointInstance") and joint.Name=="RightGrip" and joint.Part1==handle then joint.Enabled=false table.insert(r.disabled,joint) end end
   local mount=own(r,Instance.new("Motor6D")) mount.Name="CrossgroundsWeaponMount" mount.Part0=torso mount.Part1=handle
   local base=Hold.Mount(tool)
   local rest=tool:GetAttribute("RestGrip") or tool.Grip
   local function updateMount() mount.C0=base*rest:ToObjectSpace(tool.Grip) end
   updateMount() mount.Parent=torso
   table.insert(r.connections,tool:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Grip"):Connect(updateMount))
  end
  local supported=character:FindFirstChild("LeftHand")~=nil
  tool:SetAttribute("SupportGripActive",supported)
 else
  -- R6 has no elbow. Keep the native right-hand joint and approximate support
  -- with a fixed-length left arm; do not stretch or detach the shoulder.
  local arm=character:FindFirstChild("Left Arm")
  local shoulder=torso:FindFirstChild("Left Shoulder")
  if arm and shoulder and shoulder:IsA("Motor6D") then
   shoulder.Enabled=false table.insert(r.disabled,shoulder)
   local start=shoulder.C0.Position local target=torso.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(support.WorldPosition)
   local direction=target-start
   if direction.Magnitude>.05 then
    local position=start+direction.Unit*arm.Size.Y*.5
    local cf=CFrame.lookAt(position,position+direction.Unit)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,0)
    local weld=own(r,Instance.new("Weld")) weld.Name="CrossgroundsR6Support" weld.Part0=torso weld.Part1=arm weld.C0=cf weld.Parent=torso
    tool:SetAttribute("SupportGripActive",true)
   end
  end
 end
 table.insert(r.connections,tool.Unequipped:Connect(function() self:Clear(tool) end))
 table.insert(r.connections,tool.AncestryChanged:Connect(function() if tool.Parent~=character then self:Clear(tool) end end))
 table.insert(r.connections,h.Died:Once(function() self:Clear(tool) end))
end
function Rig:Queue(tool)
 if pending[tool] or records[tool] then return end pending[tool]=true
 task.delay(.08,function() pending[tool]=nil
  if tool.Parent and tool.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
   local ok,err=pcall(function() self:Attach(tool) end) if not ok then self:Clear(tool) warn("WeaponRig: "..tostring(err)) end
  end
 end)
end
function Rig:Start()
 if started then return end started=true
 local function added(value)
  if value:IsA("Tool") and value:GetAttribute("TwoHanded") then self:Queue(value)
  elseif value:IsA("JointInstance") and value.Name=="RightGrip" and value.Part1 then
   local tool=value.Part1.Parent if tool and tool:IsA("Tool") then
    local record=records[tool] if record and tool.Handle:FindFirstChild("RightHandGrip") then value.Enabled=false table.insert(record.disabled,value) else self:Queue(tool) end
   end
  end
 end
 workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(added)
 for _,value in workspace:GetDescendants() do added(value) end
end
return Rig

-- One authority for menus, saved configurations and server-side construction.
local Compatibility = {Version = 2}

local function contains(list, value)
	return typeof(list) == "table" and table.find(list, value) ~= nil
end

function Compatibility.Check(weapon, attachment)
	if not weapon or not attachment then return false, "Registro desconhecido." end
	local platform = weapon.platform
	if contains(attachment.blockedWeapons, weapon.id)
		or platform and contains(attachment.blockedPlatforms, platform) then
		return false, "Bloqueado para esta arma."
	end
	if attachment.pendingAudit or attachment.status ~= "Available"
		or attachment.auditStatus ~= "Verified" then
		return false, "Montagem pendente de verificação."
	end
	if not contains(weapon.slots, attachment.slot) then
		return false, "A arma não possui este slot."
	end
	local mount = weapon.mountPoints and weapon.mountPoints[attachment.slot]
	if not mount or mount ~= attachment.mountType then
		return false, "Ponto de montagem incompatível."
	end
	local mode = attachment.compatibilityMode
	if mode == "SpecificWeapon" then
		if not contains(attachment.compatibleWeapons, weapon.id) then return false, "Incompatível com esta arma." end
	elseif mode == "SpecificPlatform" then
		if not platform or not contains(attachment.compatiblePlatforms, platform) then return false, "Plataforma incompatível." end
	elseif mode == "Universal" then
		-- A shared rail alone is not evidence that the geometry clears this weapon.
		if not contains(attachment.verifiedMountWeapons, weapon.id) then return false, "Encaixe não verificado." end
	else
		return false, "Compatibilidade desconhecida."
	end
	return true
end

return Compatibility

local Http = game:GetService("HttpService")

local Stats = {statsSchemaVersion = 1}
local cache = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

local numericFields = {
	Damage = true,
	MinDamage = true,
	Range = true,
	FalloffStart = true,
	FalloffEnd = true,
	ProjectileSpeed = true,
	AdsSpeedMultiplier = true,
	MovementSpeedMultiplier = true,
	Cooldown = true,
	Magazine = true,
	Reserve = true,
	ReloadTime = true,
	Spread = true,
}

local vectorFields = {
	CameraRecoilMin = true,
	CameraRecoilMax = true,
}

local function finite(value)
	return typeof(value) == "number"
		and value == value
		and math.abs(value) < 1000000
end

-- Calcula os atributos de uma arma com acessórios.
function Stats.Resolve(weaponId, configuration)
	local weapon = Catalog.Get(weaponId)
	local base = weapon and Kits.Weapons[weapon.combatId]

	if not base then
		return nil
	end

	local clean = Config.Validate(
		weaponId,
		configuration or {},
		true
	)

	if not clean then
		return nil
	end

	local data = table.clone(base)
	data.AdsSpeedMultiplier = 1
	data.MovementSpeedMultiplier = 1

	local selected={} local slots={}
 for key in clean do table.insert(slots,key) end table.sort(slots)
 for _,key in slots do table.insert(selected,Attachments[clean[key]]) end
 for _, attachment in selected do

		for field, factor in attachment.statMultipliers or {} do
			local value = data[field]

			if field == "VisualRecoil"
				and typeof(factor) == "table"
				and typeof(value) == "table" then
				local recoil = table.clone(value)
				for recoilField, recoilFactor in factor do
					if finite(recoilFactor)
						and recoilFactor > 0
						and finite(recoil[recoilField]) then
						recoil[recoilField] *= recoilFactor
					end
				end
				data.VisualRecoil = recoil

			elseif finite(factor) and factor > 0 then
				if numericFields[field] and finite(value) then
					data[field] = value * factor

				elseif vectorFields[field]
					and typeof(value) == "Vector2" then
					data[field] = value * factor
				end
			end
		end

 end
 for _,attachment in selected do
		for field, amount in attachment.statAdd or {} do
			local value = data[field]

			if numericFields[field]
				and finite(value)
				and finite(amount) then
				data[field] = value + amount
			end
		end
	end

	-- Proteções para valores utilizados no combate.
	data.Cooldown = math.max(0.03, data.Cooldown)
	data.Magazine = math.max(1, math.floor(data.Magazine + 0.5))
	data.Reserve = math.max(0, math.floor(data.Reserve + 0.5))
	data.ReloadTime = math.max(0.1, data.ReloadTime)
	data.Range = math.max(1, data.Range)
	data.Spread = math.max(0, data.Spread)
	data.Damage = math.max(0, data.Damage)

	if data.MinDamage then
		data.MinDamage = math.clamp(
			data.MinDamage, 0, data.Damage
		)
	end

	return data
end

-- Obtém os atributos da Tool real.
-- Também funciona com armas sem acessórios.
function Stats.ResolveTool(tool)
	if not tool then
		return nil
	end

	local id = tool:GetAttribute("WeaponId")
	local visualId = tool:GetAttribute("VisualWeaponId")
	local raw = tool:GetAttribute("VisualConfiguration") or ""

	local old = cache[tool]

	if old
		and old.id == id
		and old.visualId == visualId
		and old.raw == raw then
		return old.data
	end

	local data = Kits.Weapons[id]

	if data and typeof(visualId) == "string" then
		local weapon = Catalog.Get(visualId)

		if weapon and weapon.combatId == id then
			local ok, configuration = pcall(
				Http.JSONDecode, Http, raw
			)

			if ok and typeof(configuration) == "table" then

			end
		end
	end

	cache[tool] = {
		id = id,
		visualId = visualId,
		raw = raw,
		data = data,
	}

end

	return {
		damage = data.Damage,
		range = data.Range,
		spreadDegrees = data.Spread,
		rpm = data.Cooldown and 60 / data.Cooldown,

			or v:IsA('Trail') or v:IsA('Beam') or v:IsA('Light') then v:Destroy()

		end
	end
end

	return setmetatable({world=world},Preview)
end
function Preview:Show(asset,id,configuration)
	local clean=table.clone(configuration or {})
	if not self.model or self.id~=id then
		if self.model then self.model:Destroy() end
		self.model=asset:Clone() safe(self.model) self.model.Parent=self.world
	else
		local changed={}
		for slot,value in self.configuration do if clean[slot]~=value then changed[slot]=true end end
		for slot,value in clean do if self.configuration[slot]~=value then changed[slot]=true end end
		for _,v in self.model:GetChildren() do if changed[v:GetAttribute('VisualAttachmentSlot')] then v:Destroy() end end

			if changed[v:GetAttribute('VisualAttachmentSlot')] then v:Clone().Parent=self.model end
		end
		-- Barrel changes also move the shot/muzzle mounts.
		local handle=self.model:FindFirstChild('Handle') local source=asset:FindFirstChild('Handle')
		if handle and source then
			for _,a in source:GetChildren() do if a:IsA('Attachment') then

				if sourcePart and sourcePart:IsA('BasePart') then v.Transparency=sourcePart.Transparency end
			end
		end
		Iron.Apply(self.model,clean.optic~=nil)
	end
	self.configuration=clean self.id=id
	return self.model
